svg.aria-label: VueAI architecture. The page, the agent run, the model, and the result, with every control.
svg.text: HOW THE AGENT USES THE PAGE
Each control, in the order a run uses it
A run moves left to right. Approval is the step that waits.
A tool can filter the table, fill the form, or write the draft
on the screen the person is already looking at.
The result returns to the same page
Each package can stand alone, and the agent can call it as a control.
